seo.title: Statement of faith
seo.description: Statement of faith of El Ancla Baptist Church: doctrinal articles and the five solas of the Reformation that guide our life and teaching.

hero.sealText: WE BELIEVE · WE CONFESS · WE PROCLAIM · WE BELIEVE · WE CONFESS · WE PROCLAIM ·
hero.body: These are the essential pillars of what we believe, teach, and live as a community of faith. Nine doctrines, rooted in Scripture, sustain and define our common life.

quote.textBefore: All Scripture is breathed out by God and profitable for teaching, for
quote.textAfter: for correction, and for training in righteousness.

christus.headlineBefore: All our faith rests on one
christus.body: Jesus Christ is the eternal Son of God, born of Mary, who lived without sin, died on the cross for his people, rose on the third day, and will return in glory. He is the absolute center of Scripture, history, and our confession.
christus.verse: For there is one God, and there is one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus.

cta.headlineBefore: If you want to talk about what we
cta.body: No summary replaces a conversation. If you have questions about any of these doctrines, write to us or come by on a Sunday.

doctrines.title: God
doctrines.subtitle: Creator, sovereign, eternal
doctrines.summary: We believe in one true God, Creator and sovereign of the universe, who made all things out of nothing and sustains them by his power.
doctrines.verse: Hear, O Israel: The Lord our God, the Lord is one.

sections.body: This one God exists eternally in three Persons: Father, Son, and Holy Spirit, equal in essence, power, and glory, yet distinct in their functions.
The three share the same divine nature and act in perfect unity.

doctrines.title: Jesus Christ
doctrines.subtitle: The only mediator
doctrines.summary: Jesus Christ is the eternal Son of God, consubstantial with the Father and the Holy Spirit. His death and resurrection are the foundation of our salvation.
doctrines.verse: For there is one God, and there is one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus.

sections.body: Jesus Christ is the eternal Son of God, consubstantial with the Father and the Holy Spirit.
Born of the virgin Mary by the work of the Holy Spirit, he lived a perfect and sinless human life.
He gave his life on the cross as the perfect and sufficient sacrifice for the atonement of his people's sins.
He rose bodily on the third day, demonstrating his victory over sin and death.
He ascended to heaven, sat at the right hand of the Father, and will return in glory as King and Lord of lords.

doctrines.title: The Holy Spirit
doctrines.subtitle: Comforter, teacher, and seal
doctrines.summary: The third Person of the Trinity, fully God, who convicts of sin, regenerates, dwells in the believer, and guides into all truth.
doctrines.verse: But the Helper, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, he will teach you all things.

sections.body: The Holy Spirit is the third Person of the Trinity, fully God, with the same divine attributes as the Father and the Son.

• He convicts the world of sin, righteousness, and judgment.
  • He regenerates and gives new life to the believer.
  • He permanently dwells in every Christian from conversion.
  • He teaches and guides into all truth.
  • He grants spiritual gifts for the building up of the Church.
The believer should live under the Spirit's control, bearing spiritual fruit.

doctrines.title: The Bible
doctrines.subtitle: Inspired and infallible Word
doctrines.summary: The inspired, inerrant, and infallible Word of God. It is our final and sufficient authority for faith and practice.
doctrines.verse: All Scripture is breathed out by God and profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for training in righteousness.

sections.body: The Bible, composed of the Old and New Testaments, is the inspired Word of God, inerrant in its original writings and infallible in all it affirms.
It is God's final and sufficient revelation to guide faith and practice, and it cannot be added to or taken away from.

doctrines.title: The Church
doctrines.subtitle: Body of Christ, family of faith
doctrines.summary: The body of Christ, composed of all true believers, expressed locally to worship, serve, and proclaim.
doctrines.verse: And he put all things under his feet and gave him as head over all things to the church.

sections.body: The Church is the body of Christ, composed of all true believers (universal church) and expressed locally in congregations that gather to worship, teach, serve, and fulfill Christ's mission (local church).

1. Glorify God.
  2. Build up the believer.
  3. Proclaim the gospel.

• Relationship: Every believer should cultivate a deep and active bond with their local church.
  • Dependence: The members of the body depend on one another to fulfill the mission.
  • Service: Spiritual gifts should be exercised for mutual edification.
  • Work: The Christian life involves intentional and active participation in the work of the Church.

doctrines.title: Humanity
doctrines.subtitle: Image of God, fallen by sin
doctrines.summary: Created in God's image, yet fallen and under condemnation, spiritually dead and in need of redemption.
doctrines.verse: So God created man in his own image, in the image of God he created him; male and female he created them.

sections.body: Created in the image and likeness of God to reflect his glory.

Because of Adam's sin, all humanity is under condemnation, corrupted in every area of its being (total depravity).

  • Enemy of God.
  • Unwilling and unable to please God.
  • Spiritually dead and enslaved to sin.

doctrines.title: Salvation
doctrines.subtitle: By grace, through faith
doctrines.summary: It is by grace, through faith in Christ, not by works. A free gift of God that includes election, justification, and sanctification.
doctrines.verse: For by grace you have been saved through faith. And this is not your own doing; it is the gift of God.

sections.body: The sovereign work of God that rescues the sinner by grace, through faith in Jesus Christ.

• Election
  • Justification
  • Regeneration
  • Sanctification
  • Glorification
The believer is kept by the power of God until the end.

doctrines.title: Ordinances
doctrines.subtitle: Baptism and the Lord's Supper
doctrines.summary: We practice baptism by immersion and the Lord's Supper as acts of obedience, symbol, and remembrance.
doctrines.verse: Go therefore and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit.

sections.body: A symbol of union with Christ in his death, burial, and resurrection.
A memorial of Christ's work and proclamation of his return.

doctrines.title: Eschatology
doctrines.subtitle: The hope of his return
doctrines.summary: Christ will return personally, visibly, and gloriously to consummate history and establish new heavens and a new earth.
doctrines.verse: Behold, I am coming soon, bringing my recompense with me, to repay each one for what he has done.

sections.body: Christ will return personally, visibly, and gloriously to consummate history and establish new heavens and a new earth.

sections.h: For the Church, this hope is
sections.body:
• A living hope.
  • A reason for comfort.
  • An encouragement toward holiness and service.
